input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding AP. Searches for "compet", "exclusive", "restrict", "shall not"/"may not"/"agrees not to" and "solicit" surface no restriction on the businesses AP may operate or the vendors it may use; the only "shall not" obligations run to Kubient's IP warranties or to AP's advertising-content standards, which are not competitive restraints. Section 1 (p0001) affirmatively disclaims exclusivity and preserves AP's right to sell Inventory through other agents or directly to third parties, and the Section 2 license is non-exclusive in AP's favour. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
